prompt: Add component traits to the agentic Switch contract in packages/agentic/components/src/components/switch. Contract work only; the implementation will consume the traits in a later change.

assertions.description: Writes `spec/traits.ts` with only type imports and one `switchTraits` literal written `as const satisfies Traits<...>`, imports `Traits` from `@fluentui-react-native/design/styling`, and does not export it from the package.
Links the constant from `SPEC.md` front matter with `traits: ./spec/traits.ts` (and optionally `traits-schema: 1`) and runs the contract checker.

Traces each value to a reviewed requirement, lists `spec/traits.ts` as that requirement's evidence, and classifies disagreements with current behavior instead of writing placeholders or silently changing behavior.
